data.name: Budair
data.gender_notes: Budair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-r-r', which means to be firm or steadfast. The name Budair refers to someone who is brave, fearless, and steadfast in the face of adversity. In Islamic history, Budair ibn Bishr was a famous companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for his bravery and unwavering faith. The name Budair carries the meaning “Brave, Fearless” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Budair usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner strength and courage that every individual possesses.
data.etymology: Budair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Fearless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Budair total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: بدير

in_arabic.long_meaning: بدير هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من اسم بدر، وهو اسم لله في الإسلام، ويعني الشخص الذي يأتي من بدر أو يتعلق به، ويستخدم في بعض الأحيان كوصف للشخص الذي يتمتع بالكمال أو النور

in_urdu.name: بدیر
in_urdu.meaning: بدیر کا مطلب ہے بدر سے متعلقہ یا بدر سے آئی ہوئی شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: بدیر ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے بدر سے متعلقہ یا بدر سے آئی ہوئی شخصیت، بدر اسلامی تقویم میں ایک مشہور چاند ہے، اور اس نام کا انتخاب اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے
